disturbance_law.SCOPE_LIMITATION: p is defined RELATIVE TO this frozen simulation disturbance law only. No claim is made about any real-world disturbance population. Every report using p must state this.
disturbance_law.application: additive command disturbance BEFORE the unchanged safety projection
disturbance_law.distribution: uniform on a disk of radius 0.05 * a_max
disturbance_law.refresh: every control step, counter-key independent, keyed by (robot_id, control_step, radius|angle)

model_output.per: one robot-local graph and one candidate topology

observation.R: the frozen replica count for the family and candidate
observation.derived_descriptive_value: k / R, stored for convenience only
observation.k: sum over replicas r of Y_{e,tau,r}

per_replica_target.naming_rule: the V3 aggregate is NEVER called Target V4
per_replica_target.outcome: Y_r in {0, 1} for replica r, determined by the unchanged full-task rollout contract

scientific_quantity.definition: P(Target-V4 task-success outcome = 1 | robot-local scientific state x, candidate topology tau, frozen disturbance law D)
scientific_quantity.expectation_form: p(x, tau) = E_D[ Y(x, tau, D) ]
scientific_quantity.support: (0, 1) for model output; the observed fraction k/R lies in [0, 1]
